title: Amazon reports Q3 revenue up 12% YoY to $201.9B, net income down 2% to $20.7B, and operating income up 61% to $28.1B; AMZN drops 8%+ after hours (Amazon)
summary: Amazon: Amazon reports Q3 revenue up 12% YoY to $201.9B, net income down 2% to $20.7B, and operating income up 61% to $28.1B; AMZN drops 8%+ after hours — Operating income was $28.1 billion and operating margin was 13.9%—Amazon's highest operating margin ever AWS net sales increased 39.3% …
